lede: The week's heaviest agenda lands Wednesday, August 19, when the Board of County Commissioners sits as the Housing Authority to dig into regional affordable housing compliance — a conversation with real stakes given how tight things are financially across the valley — while Ouray County's Planning Commission holds three public hearings the same day, including a full repeal of Section 16 of its land use code, which is the kind of change that reshapes the rules for everything that comes after. Mountain Village Town Council meets Thursday with a vote on a sale price appreciation cap that determines whether deed-restricted units actually hold their affordability over time, and Telluride's P&Z takes its first formal look at the school district's employee housing proposal at the middle-high school site.
